name: Bar compare
summary: Labeled value bars with rise-in stagger; per-bar tone override; the receipt chart.

slots.label: Unit
slots.tooltip: What the bars measure, shown small above the chart, like $ per million tokens

slots.label: Bars
slots.tooltip: The bars, left to right; each grows to its value next to the tallest

item.label: Name
item.tooltip: The short name under the bar

item.label: Value
item.tooltip: The number that sets the bar's height

item.label: Shown value
item.tooltip: The value written above the bar, as you want it read, like $15

item.label: Bar colour
item.tooltip: This bar's colour; leave it empty to take the next colour in the set

props.label: Colour
props.tooltip: The first bar's colour; the colours after it follow from this one

provenance.note: The demo is the authored EOS-001 CH02 receipt.
